judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

V. Bhavani Subbaroyan, J.:— When the Appeal came up for hearing on 13.06.2019, there was no representation for the appellant. Therefore, the matter was directed to be posted after two weeks. Again when the matter was listed on 26.07.2019, there was no representation for the appellant hence the matter was directed to be posted under the caption ‘for dismissal’. Today, viz., on 16.08.2019 also, there is no representation for the appellant.

2. Hence this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution. No costs.
